Remark
[Time interval for curvature-operator rigidity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0221 ↗ thm:curvature-operator-strong-maximum-principle 1. ch12:12.54\group Ricci Flow Applications

For complete bounded-curvature flows, nonnegativity at time zero supplies the hypothesis $\Rm (g(t))\geq 0$. The image subbundle in the theorem need not be constant on the whole interval $(0,T)$.
